ns2:course.label: Ecology and Evolution
ns2:course.description: Integrated study of ecology, population genetics, and evolution. Conceptual themes and techniques from the molecular, cellular, and organismal levels of biology will be integrated as well. Lecture, laboratory, and field work. Students may not receive credit for both IB 372 and either IB 201, IB 203, or IB 302. Prerequisite: IB 271; good standing in the IB honors biology option.
